title: Whip Crack
blurb: The whip crack — the sharp snap that punctuates burns, comebacks, and moments of someone being thoroughly told. Cartoon logic assigned this sound to sick burns decades ago and the internet upheld the ruling. Play it immediately after any roast lands to certify the hit. Also valid for actual whips, dramatic exits, and Indiana Jones cosplay.
origin: The classic whip crack, official punctuation of burns and comebacks.
